system_prompt_policy: Keep the exact previous system prompt and runtime. This is a clarification of sufficient-evidence review, not a hidden new model interface.
source_support_rules: Judge state meaning against all arrived original dialogue. Judge the submitted operation's citations separately. These error categories can overlap.

Sources must jointly support every changed or newly written semantic field, including the complete meaning of replacement text: scope, quantity, unit, polarity, strength, conditional clause and any adopted proposal. Necessary antecedents and user acceptance must be cited.

An update that omits owner/status preserves those fields and need not cite them anew solely because they are retained. Any owner/status change needs direct support. If replacement text repeats a condition, that condition is part of the submitted text and needs support in the cited set.
Do not use an advisory prior-state assertion as evidence that a requirement was authorized. Raw earlier statements can establish still-current scope and conditions.

A candidate with an omitted qualifier is wrong_value even if its broad concept is present. Independently flag its source set if that set cannot support the scope/strength/meaning it actually asserts. Do not automatically turn every wrong_value into a source error.
Minimal means no needless citations, but a sufficient superset is not a quality error solely for being nonminimal. Never reward a short but incomplete acceptance/reference chain.

Equivalent input, canonical proposal, runtime validity and semantic after-state receive one shared blinded judgment, irrespective of arm or JSON whitespace. Different references or before-state are never deduplicated.
repair_rules: Missing whole intent: add the complete still-valid requirement, including conditions, owner and status, using supplied original evidence.
Wrong text/owner/status: correct only the faulty field while preserving the other fields and all unrelated records.
Wrongly withdrawn: reopen the existing ID with the supported status; do not duplicate it. Combined reopen-and-rewrite remains unsupported.
Stale active after an explicit cancellation: withdraw, preserving its history. A tool failure or assistant assertion cannot cancel a user request.
Removing an erroneous positive instruction does not restore a valid negative constraint. Check the full post-state for that surviving obligation.
No fault-kind label, repair target, source notes, future turn or reference after-state enters any model prompt.
review_requirements: Every fresh family and fault, plus every retained family and fault, receives an independent semantic review with per-family/per-fault findings and current canonical hashes.
Keep original/revised source labels and reasons. Retained 200 targets may change citations only; semantic defects require an explicit design amendment, never a silent fix or excluded failing example.
Model-authored and model-reviewed labels remain synthetic and are not human gold.
Audit duplicates and scenario similarity across new train/dev/test and old exposed corpora before freeze; ID/hash separation alone is insufficient.
known_old_scoring_issue: The previous published judgments remain frozen. The new diagnosis documents one identical-output source-label inconsistency and source-supervision mismatches; new scoring must apply one prospective rule consistently.
